categories.name: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

species.brief: A cute real leopard gecko with a pale golden yellow body, bold chocolate spots, thick segmented tail, stout little clawed legs, large eyelidded dark eyes. Real gecko anatomy, no clothing.
species.activity: slowly licking its lips and inspecting one small green leaf

species.brief: A compact turquoise-and-coral panther chameleon with tall curved casque, bulging swiveling eyes, curled prehensile tail, zygodactyl gripping feet and a scalloped low dorsal ridge.
species.activity: gently swiveling its eyes in opposite directions and curling its tail

species.brief: A friendly real blue-tongued skink with smooth tan and brown banded scales, chunky sausage-like torso, four tiny legs, broad wedge head, glossy eyes and a short thick tapering tail. Bright blue tongue visible only on tongue-flick frames.
species.activity: basking and briefly flicking its bright blue tongue

species.brief: A charming adult female Dubia roach insect mascot, broad flat oval dark walnut-brown segmented body with amber edges, short wing pads, expressive tiny eyes, exactly six short jointed legs and two slender antennae.
species.activity: gently cleaning one antenna with a front leg

species.brief: A friendly tan-and-amber house cricket insect, slim segmented body, huge folded angular hind legs, four smaller legs, two long antennae, small dark compound eyes and short wing covers.
species.activity: rubbing a rear leg gently against a wing in a tiny chirping motion

species.brief: A living 1-Up Mushroom power-up from Super Mario Bros., iconic broad rounded vivid GREEN mushroom cap with bold white circular spots, short cream stem face with exactly two vertical black oval eyes, simple small flat base. Recognizable classic green-and-white extra-life mushroom, distinct from the red Super Mushroom.
species.activity: gently rocking in place and blinking its two eyes

species.brief: A living Fire Flower power-up from Super Mario Bros.: compact iconic orange-red circular outer petal ring, pale yellow-white inner oval face with exactly two black oval eyes, one short curved green stem and two broad green leaves. The flower itself is the character.
species.activity: gently flexing its two leaves and tilting its blossom

species.brief: Princess Peach, iconic chibi princess with long golden blonde hair, pink floor-length dress with puff sleeves and darker pink panels, white gloves, blue oval brooch and earrings, tiny jeweled gold crown, blue eyes.
species.activity: gently turning a tiny pink parasol handle with its canopy folded

species.brief: The Super Star power-up from Super Mario Bros., iconic bright golden-yellow five-point star with slightly rounded tips and exactly two tall black oval eyes centered in its body. Simple clean recognizable star, no mouth, no clothing, no arms or legs.
species.activity: tilting very slightly side to side and pulsing its golden shading in a calm loop

species.brief: A living Super Mushroom power-up from Super Mario Bros., iconic broad rounded red mushroom cap with bold white circular spots, short cream stem face with exactly two vertical black oval eyes, simple small flat base. Clear classic red and white power-up silhouette.
species.activity: gently leaning from side to side with tiny eye blinks

species.brief: An original upright black-and-white cartoon cat ska dancer in a narrow black suit, white shirt, skinny black tie, black pork-pie hat and tiny checkerboard sneakers. Friendly face, expressive eyes, small whiskers, swinging tail.
species.activity: tapping its feet and moving its elbows to a relaxed offbeat groove

species.brief: An anthropomorphic golden brass trombone, long doubled-back slide, broad bell at upper left, expressive eyes and mouth on the bell, thin dark cartoon arms with white gloves and two little feet. Instrument itself is the character.
species.activity: gently moving its short slide out and back as it sways

species.brief: An anthropomorphic golden tenor saxophone with bent neck, dark mouthpiece, downward curving conical body and upturned bell, a few readable round pearl keys, expressive eyes and mouth, tiny white-gloved arms and feet.
species.activity: pressing keys with tiny hands and swaying to a syncopated beat

species.brief: A living navy-black single quarter-note symbol with ONE filled oval notehead lower left and ONE stem rising from its right edge, NO flags. Face on notehead, tiny arms, cream gloves, little checkerboard shoes.
species.activity: tapping one foot and leaning gently on alternating offbeats

species.brief: An original small ska robot with a compact black-and-cream checkerboard square head, two amber LED eyes, tiny smiling grille, black pork-pie hat, slim charcoal mechanical body and white joint rings.
species.activity: doing a small rooted ska shuffle with bent elbows

species.brief: An original playful ska-punk moss gremlin inspired by the song title Speed of Blight: pea-green shaggy body, purple eyes, little mushroom cap tilted like a pork-pie hat, black-and-white check scarf, chunky little boots.
species.activity: rapidly tapping its tiny boots without leaving its anchor

species.brief: An original living five-point amber star ska singer inspired by the song title We Are the Stars, midnight-blue outline, smiling face centered on the star, tiny gloved hands and black ankle boots, a narrow checkerboard bow tie.
species.activity: holding one tiny unmarked microphone and swaying

species.brief: An original cheerful pale-blue ice cube mascot inspired by Cooler by the Lake: translucent-looking but opaque interior cyan cube, expressive dark eyes, simple smile, tiny black arms, white gloves and black sneakers, checkerboard sunglasses resting atop its head.
species.activity: gently fanning itself with one hand and tapping a shoe

species.brief: An original friendly pinecone ska camper inspired by the title Camp Song: warm chestnut cone-shaped body with big layered scales, round smiling face, little green knit cap, narrow check scarf, tiny arms and hiking boots.
species.activity: lightly strumming one small plain brown acoustic guitar

species.brief: An original crescent-moon ska ballroom dancer inspired by the title (In the) Ballroom: creamy gold crescent body, friendly profile face, navy vest, black bow tie, white-gloved tiny arms and two black dancing shoes.
species.activity: doing a small elegant heel-and-toe step while rooted in place

species.brief: Link in the iconic classic green-tunic design, young chibi elf-like hero with blond side-swept hair, pointed ears, long green cap, green belted tunic, cream leggings, brown boots and belt. Blue eyes.
species.activity: studying a small folded parchment map without writing

species.brief: Samus Aran in her iconic orange-and-gold armored Power Suit, red helmet and upper chest, green luminous visor, oversized round orange shoulder plates, gold legs, green arm cannon on the right arm. Chibi armored silhouette.
species.activity: adjusting her arm cannon's small indicator with her free hand

species.brief: Sonic the Hedgehog, iconic cobalt-blue cartoon hedgehog with swept-back head quills, tan muzzle and belly, joined expressive eye shape, small black nose, white gloves and red shoes with white straps.
species.activity: turning one small golden ring in a white-gloved hand

species.brief: Classic Mega Man, chibi blue robot boy with rounded cobalt helmet and pale cyan central stripe, blue bodysuit, large cobalt boots and gloves, light face panel and expressive eyes, one blue arm cannon.
species.activity: checking one little energy capsule with his free hand

species.brief: Classic cheerful Pac-Man as a round golden-yellow sphere with black oval expressive eyes, a wide wedge-shaped smile, orange gloves on thin arms and red boots. Clean arcade mascot silhouette.
species.activity: gently juggling one small round white pellet between his hands

species.theme: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
species.brief: Arthur Dent, chibi bewildered British adult man with tousled short brown hair, cream pajamas under a worn tan dressing gown, striped slippers, weary expressive face. One small folded towel in his hands.
species.activity: carefully folding and refolding his small towel

species.theme: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
species.brief: Ford Prefect, chibi cheerful eccentric adult alien disguised as a man, curly ginger-brown hair, long burgundy jacket over a brightly patterned cream shirt, dark trousers, brown boots, friendly mischievous expression. Small electronic guide in hand.
species.activity: tapping a little unmarked handheld electronic guide

species.theme: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
species.brief: Zaphod Beeblebrox from the novels: flamboyant chibi space adventurer with EXACTLY TWO distinct heads side by side, shaggy blond hair on both, big grins, turquoise jacket with orange lapels, purple trousers and boots, EXACTLY THREE arms.
species.activity: turning a tiny handheld gadget with two hands while the third adjusts his collar

species.theme: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
species.brief: Trillian, chibi brilliant adult space scientist with shoulder-length dark wavy hair, attentive dark eyes, pale teal fitted jumpsuit with orange belt and navy boots, practical small scientific scanner.
species.activity: studying a compact unmarked scanner and touching its controls

species.theme: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
species.brief: The Babel fish as a charming tiny bright yellow fish character, rounded yellow body, large curious black eyes, small puckered mouth, two little side fins, compact tail fin. Friendly exaggerated fish proportions.
species.activity: gently wiggling its fins and opening and closing its mouth as if translating

species.brief: Leeloo from The Fifth Element, chibi adult heroine with bright orange short bobbed hair and blunt bangs, white cropped T-shirt, orange rubber suspenders over gold leggings with dark thigh stripes, rugged black boots, expressive green eyes.
species.activity: examining one small stone with a simple carved geometric mark

species.brief: Korben Dallas from The Fifth Element, chibi adult man with close-cropped blond hair, square jaw, orange ribbed sleeveless undershirt, dark trousers and practical boots, mildly weary friendly expression.
species.activity: cleaning a little plain handheld radio with a cloth

species.brief: Ruby Rhod from The Fifth Element, flamboyant chibi adult presenter with dark skin, sculptural tall blond cylindrical quiff, iconic leopard-print fitted suit with a large sculpted collar and chunky black shoes, exuberant expressive face.
species.activity: speaking into one compact handheld microphone and gesturing with his free hand

species.brief: Diva Plavalaguna from The Fifth Element, chibi elegant blue-skinned alien opera singer with elongated bald blue head, long blue tentacle-like head appendages hanging behind, dark navy fitted gown and neck ornament, expressive large eyes.
species.activity: singing with one hand resting near her chest and subtle body sway

species.brief: A recognizable chibi Mangalore alien from The Fifth Element, broad wrinkled brown-gray piglike face, blunt muzzle, low folded ears, heavy brow, stocky muscular build, olive utility jumpsuit with dark straps and black boots.
species.activity: carefully adjusting one small radio earpiece

species.brief: Rick Hunter from classic Robotech anime, chibi young adult pilot with shaggy dark brown hair, blue-and-white flight suit, red neck scarf, dark gloves and white-gray flight boots. Kind determined anime eyes.
species.activity: checking one small unmarked pilot headset

species.brief: Lisa Hayes from classic Robotech, chibi adult bridge officer with shoulder-length chestnut brown hair and bangs, white high-collared military jacket with green trim, green skirt, dark tights and knee boots, poised expression.
species.activity: studying a small unmarked clipboard and touching its edge

species.brief: Lynn Minmei from classic Robotech, chibi adult anime singer with long blue-black hair, short bangs, red and white sleeveless stage dress with high Mandarin collar, white gloves and red shoes, bright cheerful eyes.
species.activity: singing into a small handheld microphone with a gentle sway

species.brief: A compact chibi VF-1S Valkyrie battloid from Robotech, white and charcoal transforming robot armor with yellow chest accents, black head with green visor and four short head cannons, blocky white legs, back fins. Recognizable Skull Leader color arrangement, no insignia text.
species.activity: examining a small maintenance tool in one mechanical hand

species.brief: A chibi Zentraedi Regult battlepod from Robotech, pale blue-gray egg-shaped armored cockpit body, narrow dark sensor slit with red optic, exactly two long reverse-jointed mechanical legs ending in broad clawed feet, two short upper barrels and compact lower barrels.
species.activity: tilting its sensor and making tiny stabilizing leg adjustments

species.brief: An original tiny living weeping willow conductor: expressive warm brown trunk face, drooping jade frond hair, two wooden branch arms, root feet, black tiny bow tie, a short ivory conductor baton. Wise and warmly theatrical.
species.activity: gently conducting a quiet musical phrase with its short baton

species.brief: An original small wingless bearded-dragon mascot made of warm brass instrument shapes: triangular scaled gold head, spiky brass beard, copper eyes, squat golden body, four short clawed legs, tail curled like a French horn coil, a little bell-shaped cheek detail.
species.activity: tilting its brass head and pulsing its bell cheeks as if humming

species.brief: An original friendly retro CRT monitor creature with a chunky warm-cream square shell, deep green screen showing a monochrome pixel face, small moss patch like hair atop its case, tiny cable arms and sturdy dark feet.
species.activity: adjusting one tiny round side knob as its phosphor face smiles

species.brief: An original midnight-blue compact coiled ball python with gold and violet star-map scale pattern, cream underside, small bright amber eyes, one continuous thick legless body and tapering tail. Galaxy markings only on scales, no surrounding stars.
species.activity: slowly lifting its head and flicking its tiny forked tongue

species.brief: An original warm coral little comet mascot with a round smiling face, short swept-back tail made of three thick gold-and-black checkerboard ribbons, tiny white-gloved arms and teal sneaker feet. Combines cosmic retro playfulness with ska style.
species.activity: bouncing subtly in place and tapping its teal sneakers on the offbeat

drafts.brief: Goomba from Super Mario Bros., iconic squat brown mushroom enemy with broad chestnut mushroom head, tan stem-like lower body, two large expressive eyes and thick dark brows, tiny white fangs at the mouth, exactly two rounded dark brown feet. No arms.

drafts.brief: A green-shelled Koopa Troopa from Super Mario Bros., iconic small yellow turtle with large friendly black eyes in pale eye sockets, short rounded yellow beak-like muzzle, green domed shell with cream rim, two little arms and two green shoes.
